# Balaji Enterprises

> Authorised distributor of hand tools, power tools, measuring instruments and industrial MRO equipment. Based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India, since 1996. 12,256 catalogued items, 243 product types, 8 categories, 6 brands with published pricing (Taparia, De Neers, Stanley, Groz, DeWalt, Black & Decker), channel partner for 20+ brands in total.

Serves manufacturers, dealers, and industrial businesses across Madhya Pradesh with ready-stock supply and same-day dispatch on stocked lines. Physical address: 118 Siyaganj Main Road, Indore, 452007 (MP), India. Phone: +91 93021 10344. Hours: Monday-Saturday 10:00-19:30 IST, closed Sunday.

## Industries served

Zone-by-zone tool and MRO checklists for eight industrial segments, each linking into the product catalogue:

- [Automotive & Auto Components](https://www.rbalajient.com/industries/automotive-auto-components/): Line-side tooling, torque control and breakdown cover for OEMs and tier suppliers.
- [Pharmaceutical & Life Sciences](https://www.rbalajient.com/industries/pharmaceutical-life-sciences/): Non-sparking, stainless and validated-spare tooling for formulation, API and packaging sites.
- [Food, Beverage & Agro Processing](https://www.rbalajient.com/industries/food-beverage-agro-processing/): Wash-down-durable tooling, H1 lubrication and seasonal stock planning for soya, poha, spice and packaged food plants.
- [Engineering, Fabrication & Job Shops](https://www.rbalajient.com/industries/engineering-fabrication/): Bench-to-dispatch fit-out, consumable reorder discipline and the full brand range on one counter.
- [Textiles & Garments](https://www.rbalajient.com/industries/textiles-garments/): High-volume small-tool supply, machine-specific kits and lubrication programme support for spinning, weaving and processing.
- [Power, Utilities & Electrical Contracting](https://www.rbalajient.com/industries/power-utilities-electrical/): Certified 1000V insulated tooling, cable termination kits and site-ready contractor sets.
- [Construction & Infrastructure](https://www.rbalajient.com/industries/construction-infrastructure/): Site delivery, loss-aware specification and IS-marked lifting equipment for contractors and developers.
- [Plastics, Packaging & Printing](https://www.rbalajient.com/industries/plastics-packaging-printing/): Mould change kits, tool room precision and blade continuity for moulders, converters and printers.
